visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a modern Mercedes-Benz vehicle, a man wearing a black baseball cap and a green zip-up jacket sits behind a white steering wheel. The digital dashboard displays glowing orange and blue gauges. A large, stylized yellow "3" overlay appears in the center of the frame against the background of the track. (2) The car begins to move forward on a flat asphalt surface bordered by green grass and orange cones. The man's hands grip the steering wheel firmly. The numbers "2" and "1" flicker in succession. Outside, a black G-Class SUV is parked near the start line under a gray, overcast sky. (3) The scene cuts to a closer view of the center console as the man's finger presses a button to select a new driving mode. On-screen text labels this as "換舒適模式." The car's interior features high-quality materials and a large panoramic screen showing vehicle diagnostics and the track ahead. (4) As the vehicle accelerates again, the camera captures the driver's focused expression and the rapid blurring of the roadside scenery. The man grips a handle above the door with his right hand as he braces for speed. The road ahead is clear except for a distant figure standing near the track. (5) A person in a black jacket suddenly steps directly into the car's path. The vehicle performs a sharp, automatic braking maneuver, causing the car's front end to dip and the driver to lurch forward. The driver's face transforms from tension to a wide, open-mouthed grin of relief and excitement.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a rhythmic synthesizer pulse and an energetic male voice counting "Three, two, one, go." At the word "go," a high-intensity electronic background music track swells with a heavy bass drum. Simultaneously, a low-frequency, granular engine idle transitions into a loud, high-arousal mechanical roar. (2) As the vehicle accelerates, the engine's spectral centroid shifts towards higher frequencies, creating a sharp mechanical timbre. The background music maintains a consistent 128 BPM tempo with percussive textures. The speaker's voice exhibits high pitch variability and a joyful, loud "Yeah!" as the speed increases during the first run. (3) A hard audio cut leads to a narrative section where the vocal tone becomes calmer and professional. The speaker's articulation is clear with moderate speech density as he describes drive modes. The music volume is ducked significantly, leaving a clean room tone within the car's interior cabin as the primary background. (4) The second acceleration sequence is triggered by a renewed engine roar and the music regaining its full amplitude. A sudden, short-bandwidth percussive "thud" and muffled tire screech signal the emergency stop. The phase concludes with a high-arousal, explosive vocal exclamation of surprise followed by rapid, positive-valence laughter and concluding speech.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Performance Test -> Feature Explanation -> Safety Test -> Reaction
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to showcase the performance and safety technologies of a Mercedes-Benz G-Class. It uses a high-energy vlog format to demonstrate rapid acceleration and the effectiveness of the vehicle's automatic emergency braking system when a pedestrian (the coach) suddenly obstructs the path.
